{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with NaN revenue (6 rows)
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check that there are three channels
print("Unique channels:", sales_df_clean['channel'].unique())

# Sum revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values(by='revenue', ascending=False)

# Display the result
total_revenue_by_channel"}
